title: それはきっと、青写真よりも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's breaktime at summer camp. I find Mejiro McQueen leafing through a pretty hefty book.
choice_data_list: What kind of book do you have there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you interested too, Trainer? Care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen beckons me over. I sit down next to her and take a look at the book…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's a photo collection which chronicles the glorious moments of the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This photo is but one of many. It shows a plaque that was earned after an arduous 3,200-meter journey, a very important memory to my grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: For every Mejiro, there lies a path forged by the greats. Which is why one day…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I, too, want to stand on that peak. I will achieve the same dream that was cherished by the Mejiros before me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes her time viewing each photo in the album. Her eyes give away the emotions welling up inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nothing, it's just that this one caught my eye. It has a different feeling to the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The photo is a scenic view taken from a hill. Observing it, I can almost hear the whistling breeze.
choice_data_list: …What a beautiful place.
…What a beautiful place.

text_block_list.text: Oh my… that's a photo one of our predecessors took during their own summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ardan? How long have you been there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Would you like me to tell you where this photo was taken? I will say, it's a bit of a steep trek, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan explains the route, likening the hike to a challenging training session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: According to the instructions Ardan gave us, first we enter the dense thicket on the left and climb the slope to the top. All right, let's make haste!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff… Phew… The breeze feels so nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together with a jovial Mejiro McQueen, I journey to the photo's location. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Trainer, I believe we still have some ways to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Is that a hornet?!
choice_data_list: Let's make a break for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… The grass is dense, and there are insects aplenty. I suppose this is the great outdoors, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, despite the hurdles, chooses to press on. I point out a detour on the map that could make it easier.
choice_data_list: (…I don't want her to push herself any further.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no road out here to follow. Plus…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The scenery we'll find is bound to be the same as the photo. As beautiful as it is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp… Is this the br-bridge?! Gulp.
choice_data_list: …We can always turn back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …But we haven't made it there yet.
choice_data_list: Why do you want to see the scenery so much?
Why do you want to see the scenery so much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Well, that's because… I've only seen it in the photo…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I haven't experienced it for myself. If I limit my dreams to photos and imagination, I'll never make them a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine, Trainer. As long as your hand is here to guide me, I can proceed forward, past this old bridge and my apprehensions.
choice_data_list: …I understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take her hand, we cross the bridge, and go over the hills. The two of us press ahead, never once looking back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: This is where the photo was taken!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Yes, indeed. But compared to the photo, this is much more…
choice_data_list: Beautiful…
Beautiful…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I expected it to look like the photo. But the reality is far more vibrant. The scent of the flowers captures my senses…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …As I thought, you mustn't settle with a simple photo or a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If we had cut our journey short, how would we have experienced the flowers' sweet scent, or the rustling of the leaves? This beauty would've been lost to us.
choice_data_list: …McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Reality is far more beautiful. More beautiful than a photo, my imagination, or my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her gaze doesn't stop at this scenery. It extends beyond, to her road of dreams…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Toward a 3,200-meter journey far more difficult than the steep and arduous path of today.
choice_data_list: (I know what she's thinking, what she's set her sights on…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want to win first place in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: For all the people who've supported my grandmother, my family, and me. The dream that they see through us—I want to make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And just like we experienced today, the achievement will be far more beautiful in reality. I want to see and feel it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal has not changed from the day we met—to win the Tenno Sho, a goal long sought by the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I apologize, I got a little carried away there. The sky feels so close from here. It's wonderful.
choice_data_list: Perhaps your predecessors wanted to share their dreams in the same way.
Perhaps your predecessors wanted to share their dreams in the same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maybe that's why they included this photo in the album…
choice_data_list: Let's take our own photo to symbolize our determination.
Let's take our own photo to symbolize our determination.
Let's commit this scenery to memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maybe that's why they included this photo in the album…
choice_data_list: Let's take our own photo to symbolize our determination.
Let's take our own photo to symbolize our determination.
Let's commit this scenery to memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Yes, we should.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This photo will be a reminder of the determination we felt today. And then, perhaps…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a new runner will travel to this same location, and declare their dreams for the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let us remember, how this scenic view that my predecessors preserved in a photo was far more beautiful in reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That way, the two of us may realize a dream far more beautiful than any photo or any desire could portray.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I take in the view with Mejiro McQueen for a little while longer.
